$meta.name: Muntin canonical design tokens
$meta.purpose: Single source of truth for the Muntin brand across BOTH surfaces: the Ledger product (Muntin-Invoice-Decoder) and the muntin.digital site (potentially-profitable). One palette, two registers.
$meta.anchor: The product's packages/ui/tokens.css is the visual anchor (financial-grade slate + blue). These values mirror it. The product re-pigment landed there; the site adopted the same DNA in commit fb86dad3f ('Wave 8b — apex muntin.digital adopts financial-grade DNA', 2026-05-16).
$meta.registers: Both registers share this palette. They differ ONLY by typography (product = Inter/Geist Mono; editorial = Fraunces display + Inter body), theme (product is dark-first; editorial is light), and which blue is primary (product fill #3b68f5; editorial uses the deeper accent.text #2a50c8 for AA on light surfaces). Editorial WARMTH is expressed through type + layout, NOT surface color.
$meta.guards: Muntin-Invoice-Decoder/scripts/check-tokens-parity.mjs locks packages/ui/tokens.css to core+themes.dark. potentially-profitable/scripts/build-tokens.mjs --check locks assets/site.css :root to the editorial register. Color comparison is case-insensitive.
$meta.hexCasing: Stored lowercase (matches the product anchor). Guards normalize case before comparing.

dark._applies_to: product register only (dark-first). Editorial/site is light-only today.

scales._note: Documented for cohesion; the color guards are the enforced lock. Radii differ by register (product = subtle rects; site = its established scale).

editorial.varStyle: legacy names (kept stable so the site re-pigments with zero selector edits)
editorial.primaryAccent: core.accent.text (#2a50c8) — the deeper blue, AA on light surfaces
editorial.warmthVia: typography (Fraunces) + generous editorial layout/measure — NOT surface color

retiredWarmPalette._note: Pre-Wave-8b editorial values. Any live occurrence (outside docs) is a migration remnant to purge, NOT a value to honor.
